description: In a chain of optionals y [K] [V], the constituent of [V] is the empty helper of [K]. So the advance into the item before [V] is itself an omission, and it needs the item before [K] to permit it. On B C K, y → B leaves out [K], but the same prefix reads B C as y and then the written K, so that omission is forbidden. No other witness reaches z, and begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text B C K
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r y [+K] [+V] z
%rule y B | B C
%rule z C K
